title: 'Evaded Payment For 16 Years': Kerala High Court Rejects Cop's Appeals Against Compensation Award To Lawyer He Assaulted
description: The Kerala High Court recently dismissed two second appeals preferred by a police officer, who was directed to pay compensation to a lawyer who he had assaulted in 2010. [2026 LiveLaw (Ker) 379] Justice Easwaran S. observed that there are no substantial questions of law raised in the regular second appeals and that the same were bereft of merits. “The dispute started in the year 2010.
